payload.last_assistant_message:
This looks correct. The implementation:

- Restricts to `http`/`https` and resolves the hostname via DNS, rejecting private/loopback/link-local IPs (covers the metadata-endpoint / internal-service SSRF cases), before ever calling `fetch`.
- Uses `redirect: 'error'` so a redirect to an internal address can't bypass the check.
- Times out after 5s and caps how much of the body is read (100KB, stopping early once `</title>` is seen) so it can't be used to pull down huge responses.
- Fetches by the parsed `URL` object (not the raw string) so the same validated target is what's actually requested.

No dependencies added — just `node:dns/promises` and `next/server`. I couldn't run `tsc`/`next build` here since `node_modules` isn't installed in this environment (installing would need approval), so I reviewed the file by hand instead.
